card.name: Of/if in stock label warnings
card.fires_on: The small word right after a fixed label instruction, mainly "of" in "Keep out of reach of children" and "if" in "Do not use if". It also fires on "well" in "Shake well".

modes.label: The phrase "Keep out of"
modes.description: The word "of" after "Keep out" in the child-safety warning, or in "Keep out of direct sunlight".
modes.example: WARNINGS: If pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health care professional before use. Keep out<< of>> reach of children. In case of overdose

modes.label: The phrase "Do not use if"
modes.description: The word "if" after "Do not use" before a description of a product defect such as particles or separation.
modes.example: breakdown of the emulsion. Do not use<< if>> there is evidence of separation of the phases

modes.label: The phrase "Shake well"
modes.description: The word "well" after "Shake" in directions for use.
modes.example: DIRECTIONS: Shake<< well>> before use. Adults & children over

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mostly unrelated odd pieces, so there is no clear output effect.
